review.notes: All six round-3 findings are repaired (passages quoted in the report). The maintainer's thirteen notes were checked against MordellLawrenceVenkatesh, TeichmullerGeometry and GroupActionsOnRiemannSurfaces at the heads of their open pull requests and GeometricTopology on main; all hold at least in part and give the ten findings. Three P2: R01, the genus, orientability and polygon model of Sigma_g, and so the hypotheses of dehn_nielsen_baer in section 3.4, are taken from MordellLawrenceVenkatesh section 5.4 and TeichmullerGeometry sections 0.0f and 4.3, which do not state them; R02, section 3.5 compares Psi_x with an action on conjugacy classes of homomorphisms that MordellLawrenceVenkatesh section 5.9 does not define (it defines the action on finite coverings); R03, the contract assumes that section 5.9's isotopy is ambient isotopy, which that section does not say. Seven P3: R04, the contract omits section 5.22 and two citations point at a Check or a narrower statement; R05, the symbols Psi and Mod^± mean something else in the suppliers; R06, GroupActionsOnRiemannSurfaces does not consume this roadmap; R07, section 2.1 does not name GeometricTopology Layer 1.7.2; R08, the H_2 clause of section 3.4 does not say how it relates to Out^+ of TeichmullerGeometry section 5.4; R09, section 3.3 restates a formula of section 5.19; R10, a wrong word in section 7.1's sketch. Checked: principles; the dependency gate (0 problems, no UPWARD or CYCLE line); supplier citations resolved on main or at the open heads; both declared gaps; the cited Mathlib and Tau Ceti declarations opened at the pins with file and line; the 15 sampled targets against the five readable sources at their cited lines; the adversarial table with computed values. Five sources are waived or uncertified and were not read. No Suggested.lean at the design stage; elaboration not available in this lane.
